options.markdown:
Redshift logs

These charts refer to the AWS Redshift logs. To configure Redshift logs see the AWS documentation.

These charts only populate with logs from Log Observer (LO) not Log Observer Connect (LOC).
See the Log Observer documentation and the Log Observer Connect documentation for more info.

chart.name: Query activity logs
chart.programText: logs(filter=field('logGroup') == '/aws/redshift/*/useractivitylog').publish()

chart.name: Connection logs
chart.programText: logs(filter=field('logGroup') == '/aws/redshift/*/connectionlog').publish()

chart.name: User logs
chart.programText: logs(filter=field('logGroup') == '/aws/redshift/*/userlog').publish()
